text: Today I'll show you how to turn a messy spreadsheet into a dashboard.
It's all in one messy sheet, and nobody knows who owes what.
Open Claude Code in the folder with your spreadsheet.
Then describe the dashboard in plain English: money by month, who owes you, and your busiest people.
In under four minutes, it cleaned two hundred and fourteen jobs and found two thousand nine hundred and fifty five pounds still owed. The prompt is in the community.
